one who judges his fellow favourably -- he is judged favourably

these too belong to acts of kindness
after the festival the householder took his wages in hand with a load of three donkeys -- food, drink and sweets -- went to his house, and after they ate and drank gave him his wages

a pious man redeemed a Jewish girl; at the inn he laid her at his feet; the next day he went down, immersed, and taught his students
the students: perhaps there is a student among us whom the rabbi has not tested
the students: perhaps from the exertion of the road the rabbi had a seminal emission
once the scholars needed something from a matron whom all the great men of Rome frequented; they said: who will go? R' Yehoshua said: I will go
when he reached her door he removed his tefillin four cubits away, entered, and locked the door before them; after he came out he went down, immersed, and taught his students
the students: the rabbi holds that words of holiness may not enter a place of impurity
the students: perhaps there is a matter of state between him and her

דתנן: מאכילין את העניים דמאי ואת האכסניא דמאי -- a mishnah citation (no support kind names a דתנן; svara stands in): demai is fit for a poor man
דמאי, הא לא חזי ליה! -- demai is not fit for him [to eat], so how may he clear it away?
כיון דאי בעי מפקר ליה לנכסיה והוה עני וחזי ליה, השתא נמי חזי ליה (= p_mafkir_nechasav_chazei)
since, if he wished, he could renounce his property and be a poor man, and it would be fit for him -- now too it is fit for him
וכי הא דאמר רבי אבהו אמר ריש לקיש -- in accordance with Reish Lakish: first tithe taken on the stalks is exempt from teruma gedola
שנאמר מעשר מן המעשר -- a tithe from the tithe, not teruma gedola and a tithe from the tithe
first tithe that [the Levite] took first while on the stalks is exempt from teruma gedola
אמר ליה רב פפא לאביי: אי הכי, אפילו הקדימו בכרי נמי ליפטר! -- if 'a tithe from the tithe' excludes teruma gedola, tithe taken first from the pile should be exempt too
עליך אמר קרא: מכל מתנותיכם תרימו -- another verse obligates the tithe taken from the pile (= p_abaye_mikol_matnoteichem)
Abaye: against you the verse says, 'from all your gifts you shall set apart' (Num 18:29) -- [tithe taken first from the pile owes teruma gedola]
ומה ראית? -- what did you see [to apply 'from all your gifts' to the pile and 'a tithe from the tithe' to the stalks]?
האי אידגן והאי לא אידגן -- this has become grain and that has not (= p_abaye_kri_idgan, p_abaye_shibolim_lo_idgan)
this [tithe taken from the pile] has become grain
it is needed only where [the Levite] took it first while on the stalks, and terumat maaser was taken from it but teruma gedola was not
the mishna: [one may clear away on Shabbat] second tithe [that was redeemed]
the clause is needed where it lies in an Israelite's hands: even then one may clear it away
